units.source_text: 源氏公子偷偷地计算，到五月初五日，明石姬所生的女孩就该过五十朝了。

en.t: Prince Genji secretly counted the days and realized that by the fifth day of the fifth month, the girl born to the Lady of Akashi would have reached her fiftieth day.

units.source_text: 他想起这孩子可爱的样子，越发想早日看到她。

en.t: Remembering how adorable the child was, he longed all the more to see her soon.

units.source_text: 他想：“若是她生在京中，今天万事都可随意安排，何等欢喜啊！

en.t: He thought, If she had been born in the capital, everything today could have been arranged just as I wished. What joy that would have been!

units.source_text: 可惜她生在穷乡僻壤，也算得命苦了！

en.t: Sadly, she was born in such a remote place; one could only say her fate is hard.

units.source_text: 若是个男孩，倒不必如此担心；

en.t: If she were a boy, I would not have to worry so much;

units.source_text: 但她是个前程远大的女孩，真是万分委屈她了！

en.t: but she is a girl with a great future before her, and this is terribly unfair to her.

units.source_text: 我此次的颠沛流离，大约正是为了这女孩的诞生而命中注定的吧。”

en.t: Perhaps all my wandering and hardship this time were destined precisely for this girl's birth.

units.source_text: 他就派使者赴明石浦，叮嘱他必须在过五十朝那一天赶到。

en.t: He then sent a messenger to Akashi Bay, instructing him that he must arrive on the very day of the fiftieth-day observance.

units.source_text: 使者果然于初五日到达。

en.t: The messenger did indeed arrive on the fifth day.
